description: Coastal Data System - Storm Tide Reference Landmarks is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. The Department of Environment and Science (DES) provided a report and has established an interactive mapping tool to help relate elevations provided by the Bureau of Meteorology's Storm Tide Advice to easily recognisable landmarks and geographic features. This tool has been created in order to aid understanding and communicating information through Storm Tide Advice Graphics. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation. Its tags are Coastal Impacts Unit, Queensland, Stormtide Advice, Stormtide Landmarks, Tides. It offers 2 resource(s) in kmz, pdf. The portal shows 2023-04-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
